powpowcity-map-editor 1.0.1

- No file changes detected.
- No user-facing changes or updates in this release.

Initial release of powpowcity-map-editor.

- Provides a zero-dependency Node.js CLI to create, edit, simulate, and share isometric city maps for PowPow City/IsoCity.
- Supports generating cities from real-world OpenStreetMap data, including Baidu Maps geocoding and China coordinate correction.
- Includes built-in commands for placing buildings, building roads, zoning districts, terraforming, taking screenshots, running the real game engine, and generating shareable browser URLs.
- Offers two operation modes: standalone editing (no dependencies) and advanced screenshot/simulation (requires Playwright and game access).
- Comprehensive Chinese documentation included for setup, commands, geolocation usage, troubleshooting, and validation steps.
